label: melisande
name: Melisande
scene: You are at the village tavern where you have been performing when an admirer comes up and talks to you.
greeting: Dance a step, share a laugh, or ask a question! Just don't ask me where I wandered last night, and we shall get along famously.
dismissal: Walk swiftly and keep to the high road. The briars have eyes this time of year, and they talk even more than I do.
